propositions: AGENTS.md currently claims symbol tools reliably resolve references without text matches, but this claim is false for symbols referenced via string literals like monkeypatch.setattr
LSP symbol resolution fails on string-literal references (e.g. monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) where the symbol name appears as a quoted string rather than a code identifier
LSP index can lag behind recent edits in the working tree, causing reported line numbers to be stale
grep produces false positives from comments and string content that LSP does not, but is necessary for finding string-literal references and current line numbers
AGENTS.md must be corrected from an unconditional preference to a decision table mapping use-case to tool selection, with the string-literal blind spot and stale-index caveat named explicitly
